**SculptForge v0.10.6 is out**
• PBR texturing phase 2: live mesh-map re-bake, fill layers and material recipes in the viewport
• Smooth keeps quad topology after Quad Remesh; Keep Masked works on real voxel remeshes
• Backface culling, a crosshair viewport cursor and a right-button pie option
• Tablet mouse mode no longer drifts from the system cursor
• Safer glTF/GLB import and a fix for an intermittent Fill layers crash
Download: https://sculptforge.app
Release notes: https://github.com/islandmed/SculptForge/releases/tag/v0.10.6
